results.role: one row per deterministic path and simulation step

iteration_summary.role: per-step descriptive summary across repeated deterministic paths

metrics.label: Illustrative token price
metrics.aggregation: mean across repeated deterministic paths at each step
metrics.description: Price emitted by the configured PriceFunction_EOE component; not a market forecast.

metrics.label: Fiat transaction volume
metrics.aggregation: mean across repeated deterministic paths at each step
metrics.description: Configured aggregate fiat-denominated transaction value for the illustrative user cohort.

metrics.label: Transaction-controller count
metrics.aggregation: mean across repeated deterministic paths at each step
metrics.description: Count emitted by the selected aggregate transaction controller; it is not an individual ledger transaction count.

metrics.label: Cumulative user participation
metrics.aggregation: mean across repeated deterministic paths at each step
metrics.description: Cumulative sum of the configured per-step cohort counts reported by TokenEconomy; it is not a distinct or active-user count.

metrics.label: Holding time
metrics.aggregation: mean across repeated deterministic paths at each step
metrics.description: Configured constant holding-time assumption used by this public scenario.

metrics.label: Token supply
metrics.aggregation: mean across repeated deterministic paths at each step
metrics.description: Configured constant supply assumption; this scenario does not model emissions or unlocks.

The emitted tables contain no liquidity depth or pool state.

The scenario models no governance process or authority.

FDV is not emitted or declared by the selected artifact contract.

repeatability.explanation: For this reviewed scenario, matching config hash and seed produce matching canonical table-content hashes. Exact file hashes also include the unique run_id lineage field.

variability.explanation: All selected controllers are deterministic, so repeated paths are identical and do not provide statistical uncertainty evidence.

interpretation_boundary: This is an illustrative, uncalibrated scenario. It is not investment, launch, legal, financial, forecast, or decision-grade advice; live decisions require qualified review and external evidence.
